subject: planner: fixing wrong result after applying predicate push down for CTEs (#47891)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: moves “outermost CTE” gating from per-LogicalCTE to shared CTEClass, computed by new `core.RecheckCTE` traversal invoked from `pkg/planner/optimize.go` and `core.BuildLogicalPlanForTest`. Predicate pushdown now correctly disables pushdown when a CTE is referenced inside another CTE definition, preventing cross-consumer semantic bleed; regression test for #47881 added. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in planner changes.
